title: Core architecture
summary: How Azure is laid out physically and how resources are organized.

resource.clue: Anything you create in Azure: a virtual machine, a database, a virtual network

resource-group.clue: A container for resources that share a lifecycle; each resource is in exactly one

subscription.clue: A unit of billing and access control that holds resource groups

management-group.clue: Groups subscriptions so that policies and access apply to all of them

region.clue: A set of datacenters in one geographic area, connected by a low-latency network

region-pair.clue: Two regions in the same geography, at least 300 miles apart, updated one at a time

sovereign-region.clue: An instance of Azure isolated from the main one, for government or compliance needs

availability-zone.clue: A physically separate location within a region, with its own power, cooling and networking
